claims.claim: Upstream video-use ships SUB_FORCE_STYLE as FontName=Helvetica,FontSize=18,...,Alignment=2,MarginV=90 against libass's default PlayResY=288, and documents MarginV as a platform safe-zone rule covering the bottom 25-30% of a vertical frame. Upstream's own SKILL.md prose says MarginV=35; the shipped code says 90.

Upstream explains the MarginV choice as a platform safe-zone rule: TikTok, IG Reels and Shorts UI covers roughly the bottom 25-30% of a 1080x1920 frame, and libass scales the render canvas relative to PlayResY=288.

The FFmpeg subtitles filter exposes a shaping option whose complex value is documented as required for complex scripts including Hebrew. Shaping performs glyph substitution and positioning, not bidirectional reordering, so it does not replace the python-bidi pre-shape.
claims.raw_snippet: Slower shaper using OpenType for substitutions and positioning

claims.claim: python-bidi's get_display accepts a base_dir parameter; without it the paragraph direction is inferred from the first strong character, so a Hebrew caption starting with a Latin token is treated as an LTR paragraph and renders in reversed word order.

https://fonts.google.com/download?family=X returns HTTP 200 with the Google Fonts HTML application shell rather than a zip archive, so a curl -f plus unzip install path silently installs nothing. The google/fonts repository serves the real variable font files.
claims.raw_snippet: Font files available from Google Fonts

claims.claim: Caption geometry expressed as fractions of frame height, derived from upstream's PlayResY=288 coordinate space. Upstream FontSize 18/288 = 6.25% of frame height and MarginV 90/288 = 31.25%, described by upstream as clearing the bottom 25-30% (about 31%) platform UI band. This skill's previous fixed values, once PlayResY was rewritten to 1920, became FontSize 52/1920 = 2.7% and MarginV 80/1920 = 4.2%, measured on a rendered frame as a caption baseline 4.6% up from the bottom. The landscape ratios retained from this skill's prior shipped behaviour are 52/1080 = 4.81% and 80/1080 = 7.41%. The sub-force-style variants remain in PlayResY=288 units, where MarginV 120 = 41.7% and MarginV 50 = 17.4%.
claims.raw_snippet: render canvas relative to PlayResY=288, so MarginV=90 lands the caption
